lines.text: بزرگی را خرد شمردن از خرد نیست مع هذا که قیاس ظنیست انرا نیز ملاحظه استعداد
lines.en: To consider greatness as small is not from wisdom, with this that analogy is conjectural, one must also observe the capacity

lines.text: زمان قبول و قوابل منظور باید داشت موافق قول بطلمیوس که النجوم منك و منها *
lines.en: of the time of acceptance and the acceptors must be kept in view, according to the saying of Ptolemy that the stars are from you and from them *

lines.text: (احکام بودن زهره مع راس) دلالت کند بر حکومت خواتین و ترقی زنان و خادمها
lines.en: (Judgments of Venus being with the Head) indicates the rule of ladies and the advancement of women and female servants

lines.text: و توبه زنان زانیه و بدکاران و سعادت و اقبال اهل غنا و بسیاری سورها و وقوع
lines.en: and the repentance of adulterous and evil-doing women, and the happiness and good fortune of the people of wealth, and many feasts, and the occurrence

lines.text: نکاحها خیر و رواج جواهر ابی و تیزی بازار صباغان و عطر فروشان و جستن بادهای
lines.en: of good marriages, and the currency of water jewels, and the briskness of the market of dyers and perfume sellers, and the blowing of winds

lines.text: خوش و حدوث بارندگی و بسیاری نعمت و فراخی معیشت خلایق و نیکی اشجار و اثمار
lines.en: pleasant, and the occurrence of rain, and much bounty and the expansiveness of the livelihood of the creatures, and the goodness of trees and fruits

lines.text: و قوت دین اسلام و اجابت دعاها و برامدن حاجات و افزونی اعطایات و ظهور زنفها
lines.en: and the strength of the religion of Islam, and the answering of prayers, and the fulfillment of needs, and the increase of gifts, and the appearance of women

lines.text: کرامات گوی و فال زن (احکام بودن عطارد مع راس) دلالت کند بر وفور نعمت و
lines.en: speaking miracles and female diviners (Judgments of Mercury being with the Head) indicates the abundance of bounty and

lines.text: بلندی اقبال وزراء و فضلا و اهل قلم و عمال و شعراء و وکلا و متصرفان و اصحاب حرف و
lines.en: the height of good fortune of viziers and the learned and the people of the pen and agents and poets and deputies and possessors and the people of crafts and

lines.text: عنایت پادشاه در حق این طایفه و کثرت بیع و شری و حدوث بارندگی در وقت و
lines.en: the favor of the king towards this group, and the multitude of buying and selling, and the occurrence of rain in time, and

lines.text: ظهور مردم فصیح و فاضل و رغبت مردم بخواندن اخبار و تواریخ و شنیدن قصه و داستان
lines.en: the appearance of eloquent and learned people, and the inclination of people to read news and histories and to hear tales and stories

lines.text: و موافق افتادن معالجات اطبا و احکام اهل تنجیم و نیکی معاملات مردم و تصحیح و تنقیح
lines.en: and the agreeable outcome of the treatments of physicians and the judgments of the people of astrology, and the goodness of the transactions of people, and the correction and revision

lines.text: دفاتر و راستی و درستی محاسبات و امانت اهل تعبیر ارباب دیوان و قوة کتاب و رواج
lines.en: of registers, and the truth and correctness of calculations, and the trustworthiness of the people of interpretation of the lords of the divan, and the strength of books and the currency

lines.text: بازار برده و دیانت مردم و گفتن مواعظ و نصایح و امدن اخبار صحیحه و نوشتن ارقام
lines.en: of the slave market, and the piety of people, and the speaking of sermons and advices, and the coming of correct news, and the writing of figures

lines.text: و امثله (احکام بودن قمر با راس) دلالت کند بر رسیدن اخبار خوش و نیکی حال
lines.en: and examples (Judgments of the Moon being with the Head) indicates the arrival of good news and the goodness of the condition

lines.text: عوام الناس و رعایا و عزت رسولان و ایلچیان و نشاط ان و قوت حال مردم و مایل شدن
lines.en: of the common people and subjects, and the honor of messengers and envoys and their joy, and the strength of the condition of people, and the inclining

lines.text: بخیرات و صدقات و ترحم کردن بر زیردستان و انصاف حکام و داروغه گان و ایمنی وکلا
lines.en: to charities and alms, and having mercy on subordinates, and the justice of rulers and police chiefs, and the safety of deputies

lines.text: اهل اسفار و اجابت دعاها و اسانی وضع حمل و رواج و روائی مهمات و امدن باران
lines.en: of the people of travels, and the answering of prayers, and the ease of childbirth, and the currency and progress of important matters, and the coming of rain

lines.text: در وقت و الله اعلم (احکام بودن زحل مع ذنب) دلالت کند بر وفور قحط و نیاز
lines.en: in time, and God knows best (Judgments of Saturn being with the Tail) indicates the abundance of famine and need

lines.text: و خرابی بقاع سیما که در بیت طالع بود و اشوب و اوارگی مردم از مساکن و اوطان و
lines.en: and the ruin of places, especially if it is in the house of the ascendant, and turmoil and the wandering of people from dwellings and homelands, and

lines.text: بدی حال پیران و کشاورزان و زحمت قلعه داران و گرفتاری ایشان و امراض مزمنه
lines.en: the badness of the condition of the old and farmers, and the trouble of fort commanders and their captivity, and chronic diseases

lines.text: مثل صرع و جنون و سایر بیماری سودائی و قولنج و استسقا و یرقان سیاه و جذام و
lines.en: like epilepsy and madness and other melancholic diseases and colic and dropsy and black jaundice and leprosy and

lines.text: کثرت جزع و فزع و ظهور مکر و ظلم و گرفتاری و خوف بزرگان از سفلگان و خرابی بیوتات
lines.en: the multitude of lamentation and terror, and the appearance of deceit and oppression, and the captivity and fear of the great from the base, and the ruin of houses

sections.en: Conjunction of Venus with the Head

summary.headline: Planetary Conjunction Judgments
summary.text: Astrological judgments for conjunctions of Venus, Mercury, and the Moon with the Head, followed by Saturn with the Tail. The omens concern rulers, women, wealth, rain, learned professions, news, public welfare, childbirth, famine, disease, turmoil, captivity, and ruin, with Ptolemy cited.
